photo-surf-scoter.back: Surf scoter drake: all black, white patches on the forehead and nape, swollen orange and white bill. The skunk head.

photo-white-winged-scoter.back: White winged scoter drake: the biggest scoter, white teardrop at the eye, white wing patch that shows in flight.

photo-black-scoter.back: Black scoter drake: all black with an orange knob on the bill. The female is dark with a pale face.

photo-long-tailed-duck.back: Long tailed duck drake: long pointed tail, bold black and white pattern that changes with the season, solid dark wings in flight.

photo-harlequin-duck.back: Harlequin duck: small; drake slate blue with white stripes and chestnut sides, hen dark brown with white face spots. Limit 2 a day, 6 in possession.

photo-common-eider.back: Common eider drake: heavy duck, white back and breast, black belly and cap, long sloping bill. Not a BC bird and no eider line in the BC federal table: a sighting, not a target.
